1257 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
295 days before 14 Nov 1257:  
Back up 30 days → 15 Oct 1257.  
Back up 9 months (Jan–Sep) → 14 Jan 1257.  
Remaining days after 14 Jan: 295 − (30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31) = 295 − 275 = 20 days earlier.  
20 days before 14 Jan → 25 Dec 1256.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1256-12-25
